title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt

title_detail.value: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt

summary: Beginning September 2026, USCIS mandates that Green Card applicants prove financial self-sufficiency to address public charge inadmissibility. This applies mainly to those pursuing family or employment-based applications, though exemptions exist for humanitarian categories such as refugees and trafficking survivors. The Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is essential but doesn't alone assure application approval. In cases of inadmissibility on public charge terms, Public Charge Bonds are an available recourse.

summary: LPU Violence LIVE: Tensions have escalated at Lovely Professional University in Phagwara, Punjab, after students protested over an alleged sexual assault claim involving a female student.The protest turned violent, with reports of large numbers of students gathering on campus, damage to university property, fires and a blockade of the Jalandhar-Phagwara stretch of NH-44. Around 2,000 students were reported to have joined the protest. Several police personnel were injured and vehicles were damaged during clashes.The allegation itself remains under investigation. Police have registered an FIR against an unidentified person and constituted a Special Investigation Team to examine the claim, including CCTV footage and other evidence. At the same time, LPU has denied that the alleged sexual assault occurred and described the claims circulating on social media as false and fabricated.Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has directed the state police leadership to look into the situation.
